purpose: Locate fixed-weight dependence in the learned PC01-minus-warm readout changes. This is not a training-process causal decomposition or a replacement search.
factors: all output biases, including fallback location/scale
contrasts: ALL8 binary combinations of warm versus PC01final blocks, no branch selection. Same unchanged raw inputs/anchors/probability arithmetic. All mode, fallback-gate and fallback-parameter rows participate.
cohorts: Original128fit plus same two128controls; all previously seen by warm encoder/head. Fit rows in-sample, controls excluded only from PC01 optimization.
metrics: Conditional integer exactness, normalized NLL, bounded candidate rank, marginalized explanation shares; preserve both endpoint parity.
limitations: Explicit-input weight intervention does not remove indirect priority information from context or analytic exact anchor. Block effects can interact through probability normalization and duplicate point aggregation. No Fish-intent attribution.
